actions_by_tier.Medium: Approved with Standard Automated Verification Check
actions_by_tier.High: Escalate to Senior Underwriter for Manual Committee Review
actions_by_tier.Critical: Adverse Decision / Automated Decline or Secured Exception Only

tradeoff_explanation: In consumer credit, a default (False Negative) costs ~$10,000 in unrecoverable loan principal, whereas an unnecessary manual review or rejection (False Positive) costs ~$1,200 in underwriting overhead and lost net interest margin. Lowering the operational decision threshold from 0.50 to 0.24 increases defaulter recall from 28.4% to 74.2%, reducing expected portfolio credit loss by $1.84M per 10,000 applicants.
